versions.changelog:
Initial release of forklift-benchmark skill with FK-Bench v2 embodied forklift intelligence evaluation benchmark.

- Provides a fully self-contained benchmark to test and score forklift task instructions with no external API required.
- Includes 722 questions (6 modules × 7 scenes × 3 difficulty levels), covering navigation, load/fork actions, safety compliance, situational reasoning, and more.
- Implements a three-layer scoring engine (red line veto + LCS + parameter IoU) for granular evaluation.
- Supports question sampling, structured predictions, automated scoring, and visualization report generation.
- Built-in knowledge base and detailed references for DSL actions, standards, scoring, and data schema.
- Datasets and scripts are packaged securely, with clear licensing and copyright.
- Enables both model benchmarking and self-evaluation workflows for embodied AI applications.
